sloka: गिरि वरम् अभितो अनुवर्तमानो ।हय इव मण्डलम् आशु यः करोति ।तम् इह शरणम् अभ्युपेहि देविदिवस करम् प्रभवो ह्ययम् प्रजानाम् ६-३३-३९
transliteration: giri varam abhito anuvartamāno ।haya iva maṇḍalam āśu yaḥ karoti ।tam iha śaraṇam abhyupehi devidivasa karam prabhavo hyayam prajānām 6-33-39

translations.english: "Approach here for refuge, lady, that maker of day who wheels about the best of mountains and swiftly makes his circuit like a horse; for he indeed is the source of creatures."
